description: Death drops every slot (#233): a client player holds items in the hotbar, the main inventory, all four armour slots and the off hand, picks a stack onto its cursor and puts two items of it into the 2x2 crafting grid (container_click PICKUP), then dies (/kill at tick 10). Inventory.dropAll throws the inventory and equipment at death; the cursor stack and the crafting grid drop when the client asks to respawn (client_command at tick 20, Player.remove of the dead player). The client view shows the inventory menu sync after the respawn (no ghost items).
